qr/1/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/1/0.note: RFM p.2.4-1 (NR placard, Figure): '320 rpm Min. power-off'. Confirmed on the rendered page image.

qr/1/1.context: Quick Reference group 'Rotor Speed (Nr)', item 'Normal operating range'
qr/1/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025

qr/1/2.context: Quick Reference group 'Rotor Speed (Nr)', item 'Aural warnings'
qr/1/2.text: Low Nr aural warning: ≤ 360 rpm. / High Nr aural warning: ≥ 410 rpm.
qr/1/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025

qr/2/0.context: Quick Reference group 'Engine Torque Limits (TQ %)', item 'Arriel 2B1 (AEO)'
qr/2/0.text: Maximum continuous: 92.7 %. / Takeoff rating: 100 % (92.7–100 % torque range placarded for 0–40 kt). / Transient (5 s): 104 %. / 100 % torque = 535 kW at NR 386 rpm. / Use of the takeoff rating torque range has no time limit.
qr/2/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/2/0.note: RFM p.2.4-2 (Torque placard, Figure): '92.7% Max. continuous rating', '92.7% to 100% Takeoff rating torque range from 0 to 40 kt', '100% Max. takeoff rating torque', '104% Max. transient torque (5 sec.)'. Confirmed on the rendered page image; the '0 to 40 kt' qualifier on the placard was missing from the app and has been added.

qr/2/1.context: Quick Reference group 'Engine Torque Limits (TQ %)', item 'Engine takeoff rating'
qr/2/1.text: Use of the engine takeoff rating range is limited to 5 continuous minutes. / Heating and demisting are forbidden above the engine maximum continuous rating (Ng or t4).
qr/2/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/2/1.note: RFM p.2.4-2: 'Use of engine takeoff rating range, is limited to 5 continuous minutes' and 'Use of heating and demisting is forbidden above the engine maximum continuous rating (Ng or t4)'. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/3/0.context: Quick Reference group 'Engine Speeds (Ng / Nf)', item 'Ng (gas generator)'
qr/3/0.text: Minimum stabilized rating: 67 %. / Maximum continuous: ΔNg = -4 % (Ng 97.1 % at Hp = 0, ISA). / Takeoff rating range: ΔNg = -4 % to 0 %; maximum takeoff: ΔNg = 0 % (Ng 101.1 %). / Maximum transient: ΔNg = +1 % (Ng 102.3 %, 5 s). / 100 % Ng = 52 110 rpm.
qr/3/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/3/0.note: RFM p.2.4-3 (Ng LIMITATIONS + Ng placard): Ng=67% mini stabilized, dNg=-4% max continuous (Ng=97.1%), takeoff range dNg=-4% to 0% (Ng=101.1%), transient dNg=+1% (Ng=102.3%, 5s), 100% Ng = 52110 rpm. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/3/1.context: Quick Reference group 'Engine Speeds (Ng / Nf)', item 'Nf (power turbine)'
qr/3/1.text: Minimum: 349 rpm; normal operating range: 349–418 rpm. / Maximum continuous: 418 rpm. / Maximum transient: 450 rpm (5 s). / NR 386 rpm = Nf 39 158 rpm.
qr/3/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/3/1.note: RFM p.2.4-3 (Nf placard, Figure): '349 rpm Mini', '349 to 418 rpm Normal operating range', '418 rpm Max. continuous', '450 rpm Max. transient limit (5 sec.)'; NOTE 'A NR rotor speed of 386 rpm corresponds to a Nf speed of 39158 rpm'. Confirmed on the rendered page image.

qr/4/0.context: Quick Reference group 'Turbine Outlet Temperature (T4 °C)', item 'Start'
qr/4/0.text: Max continuous during start: 750 °C. / Transient during start (10 s): 865 °C.
qr/4/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/4/0.note: RFM p.2.4-3 (t4 Starting limitations placard): '750°C Max. continuous', '865°C Max. transient (10 sec)'. Confirmed on the rendered page image.

qr/4/1.context: Quick Reference group 'Turbine Outlet Temperature (T4 °C)', item 'Flight'
qr/4/1.text: Max continuous in flight: 849 °C. / Takeoff rating range: 849–915 °C; maximum takeoff rating: 915 °C. / Maximum transient: 941 °C (20 s).
qr/4/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/4/1.note: RFM p.2.4-3 (t4 Flight limitations placard): '849°C Max. continuous rating', '849°C to 915°C Takeoff rating range', '915°C Max. temperature takeoff rating', '941°C Max. transient (20 sec)'. Confirmed on the rendered page image.

qr/5/0.context: Quick Reference group 'Weight & Loading (selected)', item 'Internal weight limits'
qr/5/0.text: Maximum permissible internal weight in flight: 2250 kg (4961 lb). / Maximum permissible internal weight for IGE take-off and landing: 2250 kg (4961 lb).
qr/5/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/5/0.note: RFM p.2.2-1: 'Maximum permissible internal weight in flight: 2250 kg (4961 lb)', 'Maximum permissible internal weight for IGE, take-off and landing: 2250 kg (4961 lb)'. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/5/1.context: Quick Reference group 'Weight & Loading (selected)', item 'Cargo compartments'
qr/5/1.text: RH cargo compartment: max 100 kg. / LH cargo compartment: max 120 kg. / Rear cargo compartment: max 80 kg.
qr/5/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/5/1.note: RFM p.2.5-6 (BAGGAGE COMPARTMENT LOAD LIMITATIONS): RH cargo compartment 100 kg (220 lb), LH cargo compartment 120 kg (264 lb), Rear cargo compartment 80 kg (176 lb). Confirmed verbatim.

qr/5/2.context: Quick Reference group 'Weight & Loading (selected)', item 'Cabin floor'
qr/5/2.text: Rear cabin floor: max 310 kg. / Forward left cabin floor: max 150 kg.
qr/5/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/5/2.note: RFM p.2.5-6 (CABIN COMPARTMENT LOAD LIMITATIONS): Rear cabin floor 310 kg (682 lb), Forward left cabin floor 150 kg (330 lb). Confirmed verbatim.

qr/6/0.context: Quick Reference group 'Ground & Slope Limits', item 'Landing / rotor stop slopes'
qr/6/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/6/0.note: RFM p.2.3-4 (LANDING AND ROTOR STOPPING LIMITATIONS ON SLOPE): Nose up 10°, Nose down 6°, Sideways 8°. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/6/1.context: Quick Reference group 'Ground & Slope Limits', item 'Engine start'
qr/6/1.text: Prohibited if snow or ice has collected in or around the engine air intake.
qr/6/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/6/1.note: RFM Section 2.1 (TYPE OF OPERATIONS, forbidden list): 'Engine starting when snow or ice accumulations are in or around the engine air intake'. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/7/0.context: Quick Reference group 'Systems (selected limits)', item 'Engine oil'
qr/7/0.text: Maximum oil temperature: 115 °C (caution range -10 °C to 0 °C). / Minimum oil temperature before power application: 0 °C (oil 5 cSt). / Minimum oil pressure (Ng ≥ 70 %): 1.1 bar (16 psi); caution ranges 1.1–2 bar and 6–9.8 bar. / Maximum oil pressure: 9.8 bar (142 psi).
qr/7/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/7/0.note: RFM p.2.4-4 (OIL TEMPERATURE and OIL PRESSURE placards): 115°C max temperature, -10 to 0°C caution range, min 0°C before power application (oil 5 cSt); 1.1 bar (16 psi) mini pressure (Ng>=70%), caution ranges 1.1-2 and 6-9.8 bar, 9.8 bar (142 psi) max. Confirmed on the rendered page image.

qr/7/1.text: Maximum voltage: 31.5 V (rated range 26–29 V). / Maximum continuous current: 150 A.
qr/7/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/7/1.note: RFM p.2.4-4 (5 ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT LIMITATIONS): Maximum voltage 31.5V (rated 26-29V), Maximum current 150A max continuous (for 200A starter generator if fitted, refer to SUP.29 - not currently reflected in the app line, a minor completeness gap not an error). Confirmed verbatim.

qr/7/2.context: Quick Reference group 'Systems (selected limits)', item 'Fuel anti-icing'
qr/7/2.text: Fuel anti-icing additive mandatory if OAT < -20 °C and the fuel does not contain a freezing inhibitor.
qr/7/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/7/2.note: RFM p.2.5-3 (ADDITIVES, Anti-ice additives): 'If the fuel does not contain a freezing inhibitor and if the OAT is below -20°C, the use of an anti-icing additive is mandatory'. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/8/0.context: Quick Reference group 'Optional equipment limits (supplements)', item 'Emergency floatation gear (SUP.17)'
qr/8/0.text: Emergency landing on water only; no takeoff after landing on water. / Max IAS with gear stowed and armed or inflated: 135 kt (250 km/h) power on; 100 kt (185 km/h) with torque below 40 %. / Maximum altitude for float inflation: 6600 ft (2000 m). / Gear must be armed below 400 ft (122 m) above water. / Minimum weight with OAT < 0 °C: 1480 kg (3263 lb). / Recommended inflation IAS: below 80 kt (148 km/h).
qr/8/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/8/0.note: RFM SUP.17 p.2 (LIMITATIONS): emergency landing on water only, takeoff after prohibited, 135 kt power on / 100 kt with TQ<40%, max altitude 6600 ft, gear armed below 400 ft, min weight 1480 kg OAT<0°C; SUP.17 p.3 (INFLATION PROCEDURE): recommended firing IAS below 80 kt. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/8/1.context: Quick Reference group 'Optional equipment limits (supplements)', item 'External loads (SUP.12 sling / SUP.13 swing) — only the installation fitted applies'
qr/8/1.text: Cargo swing (SUP.13, 13.1, 13.2 — suspended pyramid frame with a SIREN or ON-BOARD release unit): max 1400 kg (3086 lb). / Cargo sling (SUP.12 — Breeze Eastern release unit and hook, P/N 17149-1): max 750 kg (1660 lb). / Maximum all-up weight with external load: 2800 kg (6173 lb) or the OGE-hover maximum, whichever is lower. / Maximum IAS with external load: 80 kt (148 km/h). / Non-human external cargo only; jettisonable loads only.
qr/8/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/8/1.note: RFM SUP.13/13.1/13.2 p.2 (WEIGHT LIMITATION): 1400 kg (3086 lb) swing; SUP.12 p.2: 750 kg (1660 lb) sling; both: 2800 kg (6173 lb) all-up or OGE-hover max, whichever lower; SUP.12/13 p.3 (AIRSPEED LIMITATION): 80 kt max with external load; SUP.12 p.4 (OPERATING LIMITATION): NHEC only, jettisonable loads only. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/8/2.context: Quick Reference group 'Optional equipment limits (supplements)', item 'Hoist (SUP.18 / 19)'
qr/8/2.text: Maximum load on cable: 136 kg (300 lb) (SUP.18) or 204 kg (450 lb) (SUP.19). / Minimum crew: pilot and hoist operator. Landing with a load on the cable is prohibited. / Hoist failure return: VNE 60 kt (111 km/h) with the cable slightly inclined.
qr/8/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/8/2.note: RFM SUP.18 p.3 (LIMITATIONS): one pilot + one hoist operator, 136 kg (300 lb) max load, landing with load prohibited; SUP.18 p.4 (HOIST FAILURE): return with VNE 60 kt (111 km/h), cable slightly inclined; SUP.19 p.3: 204 kg (450 lb) max load, same crew/landing/VNE rules. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/8/3.context: Quick Reference group 'Optional equipment limits (supplements)', item 'Bambi bucket (SUP.52)'
qr/8/3.text: Capacity 1225 litres. / VNE 90 kt (167 km/h) empty; 80 kt (148 km/h) full or partly filled.
qr/8/3.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/8/3.note: RFM SUP.52 p.1 (GENERAL): 'Maximum capacity: 1225 litres'; SUP.52 p.2 (LIMITATIONS, Speed limitations): empty bucket VNE=90 kt (167 km/h), full or partially filled VNE=80 kt (148 km/h). Confirmed verbatim.

qr/8/4.context: Quick Reference group 'Optional equipment limits (supplements)', item 'Sand filter (SUP.14)'
qr/8/4.text: Heating and demisting OFF when P2 is ON (sand filter active). / Flight in falling snow is permitted with no restriction when the sand filter is fitted, active or not — the visibility-based snow limits (10 min between 800–1500 m, prohibited below 800 m) only apply without the sand filter installed.
qr/8/4.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/8/4.note: FIXED (was materially wrong): RFM SUP.14 p.1 (LIMITATIONS) has only two bullets - 'heating and demisting must be switched off when sand filter is active' and 'flight under falling snow is permitted without any restrictions when sand filter is fitted (active or not)'. The app previously claimed a 'P2 OFF in visible moisture below 0°C' rule and that falling-snow flight required the sand filter AND P2 OFF - neither is in the RFM; rewritten to match the RFM exactly, cross-referencing the base aircraft's visibility-based snow limits (Section 2.3 §7) which the sand filter supplement overrides.

qr/8/5.context: Quick Reference group 'Optional equipment limits (supplements)', item 'AFCS SFIM 85 T 31 (SUP.16)'
qr/8/5.text: Minimum height for hands-off operation: 400 ft (120 m). / Minimum all-up weight with AFCS in operation: 1300 kg (2866 lb). / Disengaged on the ground except for checks; no engagement before takeoff if the trim test is not satisfactory.
qr/8/5.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/8/5.note: RFM SUP.16 p.4 (2 LIMITATIONS): 'When aircraft is on ground, AFCS must be disengaged except if checks are to be performed', 'Do not engage AFCS before takeoff if trim test is not satisfactory', 'Minimum height for AFCS hands-off operation: 400 ft (120 m)'. ADDED (real omission, was entirely missing from the app): '2.3 WEIGHT LIMITATION - Minimum all-up weight with AFCS in operation: 1300 kg (2866 lb)'.

qr/8/6.context: Quick Reference group 'Optional equipment limits (supplements)', item 'Dual hydraulic system (SUP.23)'
qr/8/6.text: Do not exceed a load factor that lights LIMIT. / HYD1 or HYD2 with SERVO: bank below 30°, IAS below 110 kt (204 km/h) or VNE if less.
qr/8/6.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/8/6.note: RFM SUP.23 p.4 (2.1 MANEUVERING LIMITATIONS): 'Do not exceed a load factor that causes LIMIT light to come on'; SUP.23 p.6 (3.2.2 hydraulic alarms, HYD1/HYD2+SERVO): 'Maintain angle of bank less than 30°. Maintain IAS below 110 kt (204 km/h) (or VNE if less)'. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/8/7.context: Quick Reference group 'Optional equipment limits (supplements)', item 'Increased internal gross weight (SUP.28)'
qr/8/7.text: Maximum internal weight in flight and for IGE takeoff and landing: 2370 kg (5225 lb).
qr/8/7.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/8/7.note: RFM SUP.28 p.1 (2.2 WEIGHT LIMITATION): 'Maximum internal weight in flight 2370 kg (5225 lb)', 'Maximum internal weight for IGE, take-off and landing 2370 kg (5225 lb)'. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/9/0.context: Quick Reference group 'Crew & Operational Use', item 'Approved operations'
qr/9/0.text: Approved for day and night VFR. / Flight in icing conditions is not permitted.
qr/9/0.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/9/0.note: RFM Section 2.1 §1 (TYPE OF OPERATIONS): approved by day and night VFR; forbidden list includes 'Flight in freezing rain or icing conditions'. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/9/1.context: Quick Reference group 'Crew & Operational Use', item 'Crew & occupancy'
qr/9/1.text: Minimum crew: 1 pilot in the right seat. / Maximum persons on board (including crew): 6.
qr/9/1.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/9/1.note: RFM Section 2.1 §2 (OCCUPANTS): 'Minimum flight crew: One pilot in right seat', 'Maximum number of occupants (including flight crew): Six'. Confirmed verbatim.

qr/9/2.context: Quick Reference group 'Crew & Operational Use', item 'Prohibited operations (selected)'
qr/9/2.text: Aerobatic manoeuvres: prohibited. / Intentional engine power reduction in flight using the twist grip: prohibited (except where explicitly allowed for training/emergency procedures in the RFM).
qr/9/2.source_rev: AS350 B3 2B1 Flight Manual, EASA certification, dated 10/01/2025
qr/9/2.note: RFM Section 2.1 §1 forbidden list: 'Aerobatic maneuvers' and 'In-flight engine power reduction using twist grip control except for engine failure training, emergency procedures referring to it'. Confirmed verbatim.
